prompt.v: The histogram shows some weights of packages, in kg. Which measure of spread describes it better?

options.label: The standard deviation, with the mean

problems.explain: The rule: with an outlier, or data that is clearly skewed, use the IQR; with roughly symmetric data and no outlier, use the standard deviation. The bars trail off to the left, and the values in that tail pull the mean and stretch the standard deviation. The IQR, built on quartiles, is not moved by them. (The same reasoning as an outlier: a few far values should not set the spread.) So the IQR, with the median.
